<!DOCTYPE html>

<html class="light" lang="en"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no" name="viewport"/>
<title>FPT ExamHub - Login</title>
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com?plugins=forms,container-queries"></script>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:wght,FILL@100..700,0..1&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:wght,FILL@100..700,0..1&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<script id="tailwind-config">
        tailwind.config = {
            darkMode: "class",
            theme: {
                extend: {
                    colors: {
                        "background": "#f8f9ff",
                        "surface-tint": "#ac3400",
                        "surface-container-highest": "#d3e4fe",
                        "tertiary-container": "#447a9c",
                        "secondary-fixed": "#d5e3ff",
                        "secondary-container": "#bbd3fd",
                        "on-secondary-fixed": "#001b3c",
                        "tertiary": "#286182",
                        "primary-fixed": "#ffdbd0",
                        "on-primary-fixed-variant": "#842600",
                        "on-tertiary-container": "#fcfcff",
                        "on-surface": "#0b1c30",
                        "error": "#ba1a1a",
                        "primary-container": "#d14307",
                        "on-secondary-fixed-variant": "#30476a",
                        "on-primary-container": "#fffbff",
                        "on-secondary": "#ffffff",
                        "outline-variant": "#e2bfb4",
                        "on-tertiary-fixed-variant": "#064c6b",
                        "on-surface-variant": "#5a4139",
                        "error-container": "#ffdad6",
                        "on-primary-fixed": "#390b00",
                        "primary-fixed-dim": "#ffb59d",
                        "inverse-primary": "#ffb59d",
                        "on-error": "#ffffff",
                        "surface-container-low": "#eff4ff",
                        "secondary": "#485f84",
                        "on-error-container": "#93000a",
                        "surface-container": "#e5eeff",
                        "surface": "#f8f9ff",
                        "on-tertiary-fixed": "#001e2e",
                        "inverse-surface": "#213145",
                        "on-tertiary": "#ffffff",
                        "tertiary-fixed": "#c7e7ff",
                        "primary": "#a83300",
                        "brand-primary": "#F15A22",
                        "brand-navy": "#1D3557",
                        "surface-dim": "#cbdbf5",
                        "surface-bright": "#f8f9ff",
                        "surface-variant": "#d3e4fe",
                        "surface-container-lowest": "#ffffff",
                        "on-background": "#0b1c30",
                        "outline": "#8e7067",
                        "on-secondary-container": "#445a7f",
                        "on-primary": "#ffffff",
                        "secondary-fixed-dim": "#b0c7f1",
                        "tertiary-fixed-dim": "#98cdf2",
                        "surface-container-high": "#dce9ff",
                        "inverse-on-surface": "#eaf1ff"
                    },
                    borderRadius: {
                        "DEFAULT": "0.25rem",
                        "lg": "0.5rem",
                        "xl": "0.75rem",
                        "input": "10px",
                        "card": "16px",
                        "btn": "12px",
                        "full": "9999px"
                    },
                    spacing: {
                        "xs": "8px",
                        "gutter": "12px",
                        "xl": "32px",
                        "sm": "12px",
                        "md": "16px",
                        "base": "4px",
                        "lg": "24px",
                        "container-padding": "16px"
                    },
                    fontFamily: {
                        "inter": ["Inter", "sans-serif"],
                        "label-md": ["Inter"],
                        "display-lg": ["Inter"],
                        "body-md": ["Inter"],
                        "body-lg": ["Inter"],
                        "title-lg": ["Inter"],
                        "headline-sm": ["Inter"],
                        "headline-md": ["Inter"]
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    </script>
<style>
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            background-color: #FAFAFA;
            -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
        }
        .form-shadow {
            box-shadow: 0px 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
        }
        .input-focus-ring:focus-within {
            border-color: #F15A22;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #F15A22;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="flex flex-col min-h-screen items-center justify-start overflow-x-hidden">
<!-- Top AppBar (Identity Block) -->
<header class="w-full pt-16 pb-8 flex flex-col items-center gap-md">
<img alt="FPT ExamHub Logo" class="w-[56px] h-[56px] object-contain" src="data:image/png;base64,"/>
<div class="text-center">
<h1 class="font-bold text-[24px] leading-tight text-brand-navy">Welcome back 👋</h1>
<p class="text-[14px] font-normal text-[#6B7280] mt-xs">Sign in to your FPT account</p>
</div>
</header>
<!-- Main Content Canvas -->
<main class="w-full px-container-padding max-w-[400px]">
<!-- Form Card -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-card p-[20px] form-shadow w-full flex flex-col gap-lg">
<form class="flex flex-col gap-md" id="loginForm">
<!-- Email Input -->
<div class="flex flex-col gap-xs">
<label class="text-[12px] font-medium text-brand-navy ml-1">Email address</label>
<div class="relative flex items-center h-[52px] w-full rounded-input bg-[#F1F5F9] border border-transparent transition-all input-focus-ring group">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined absolute left-md text-[#9CA3AF] pointer-events-none" data-icon="mail">mail</span>
<input class="w-full h-full pl-11 pr-md bg-transparent border-none focus:ring-0 text-brand-navy placeholder-[#9CA3AF] text-body-md" placeholder="Email address" required="" type="email"/>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Password Input -->
<div class="flex flex-col gap-xs">
<label class="text-[12px] font-medium text-brand-navy ml-1">Password</label>
<div class="relative flex items-center h-[52px] w-full rounded-input bg-[#F1F5F9] border border-transparent transition-all input-focus-ring group">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined absolute left-md text-[#9CA3AF] pointer-events-none" data-icon="lock">lock</span>
<input class="w-full h-full pl-11 pr-11 bg-transparent border-none focus:ring-0 text-brand-navy placeholder-[#9CA3AF] text-body-md" id="passwordInput" placeholder="Password" required="" type="password"/>
<button class="absolute right-md text-[#9CA3AF] hover:text-brand-primary active:scale-95 transition-all" onclick="togglePassword()" type="button">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined" data-icon="visibility" id="passwordToggleIcon">visibility</span>
</button>
</div>
<div class="w-full text-right">
<a class="text-[13px] font-medium text-brand-primary hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity" href="#">Forgot Password?</a>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Sign In Button -->
<button class="w-full h-[52px] bg-brand-primary rounded-btn text-white font-semibold text-[15px] active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform duration-150 flex items-center justify-center gap-xs" type="submit">
                    Sign In
                </button>
</form>
<!-- Divider -->
<div class="flex items-center gap-md">
<div class="h-[1px] flex-1 bg-[#E2E8F0]"></div>
<span class="text-[12px] text-[#9CA3AF] font-normal">or continue with</span>
<div class="h-[1px] flex-1 bg-[#E2E8F0]"></div>
</div>
<!-- Social Provider -->
<button class="w-full h-[48px] bg-white border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-input flex items-center justify-center gap-md active:bg-gray-50 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all">
<svg fill="none" height="20" viewbox="0 0 24 24" width="20" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<path d="M22.56 12.25c0-.78-.07-1.53-.2-2.25H12v4.26h5.92c-.26 1.37-1.04 2.53-2.21 3.31v2.77h3.57c2.08-1.92 3.28-4.74 3.28-8.09z" fill="#4285F4"></path>
<path d="M12 23c2.97 0 5.46-.98 7.28-2.66l-3.57-2.77c-.98.66-2.23 1.06-3.71 1.06-2.86 0-5.29-1.93-6.16-4.53H2.18v2.84C3.99 20.53 7.7 23 12 23z" fill="#34A853"></path>
<path d="M5.84 14.09c-.22-.66-.35-1.36-.35-2.09s.13-1.43.35-2.09V7.07H2.18C1.43 8.55 1 10.22 1 12s.43 3.45 1.18 4.93l3.66-2.84z" fill="#FBBC05"></path>
<path d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15C17.45 2.09 14.97 1 12 1 7.7 1 3.99 3.47 2.18 7.07l3.66 2.84c.87-2.6 3.3-4.53 6.16-4.53z" fill="#EA4335"></path>
</svg>
<span class="text-brand-navy font-medium text-[14px]">Continue with Google</span>
</button>
</div>
</main>
<!-- Simple Footer (No Nav) -->
<footer class="w-full mt-auto pb-xl px-container-padding flex justify-center items-center">
<p class="text-[14px] text-brand-navy">
            Don't have an account? 
            <a class="font-bold text-brand-primary ml-1 hover:underline" href="#">Register</a>
</p>
</footer>
<script>
        function togglePassword() {
            const passwordInput = document.getElementById('passwordInput');
            const toggleIcon = document.getElementById('passwordToggleIcon');
            if (passwordInput.type === 'password') {
                passwordInput.type = 'text';
                toggleIcon.innerText = 'visibility_off';
            } else {
                passwordInput.type = 'password';
                toggleIcon.innerText = 'visibility';
            }
        }

        // Simple form interaction
        document.getElementById('loginForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            // Animation for feedback
            const btn = e.target.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
            const originalText = btn.innerText;
            btn.innerHTML = '<span class="animate-spin h-5 w-5 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full"></span>';
            btn.disabled = true;
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                btn.innerHTML = 'Success!';
                btn.classList.replace('bg-brand-primary', 'bg-green-500');
            }, 1000);
        });
    </script>
</body></html>
